sloka: शात कुम्भमयीम् रम्याम् मणि रत्न समाकुलाम् ।सुधर्माम् इव धर्म आत्मा सगणः प्रत्यपद्यत ॥२-८१-१०॥
transliteration: śāta kumbhamayīm ramyām maṇi ratna samākulām ।sudharmām iva dharma ātmā sagaṇaḥ pratyapadyata ॥2-81-10॥

translations.english: Righteous Vasistha along with his disciples reached the lovely golden assembly hall inlaid with gems and precious stones, which resembled Sudharma, (the assembly hall of Indra).
translations.hindi: शत्र घन जी यह बातछुन, अत्यन्त ही दुःखित हो तथा कत्त व्य कर्म निश्चय कर, सब अन्तःपुरचारियाँ से यह बोले
